segments.why: Take 2 of the hook, continued: '(I) gave myself one hour to build an AI video editor'. The only take that says 'AI'; take 3 adds 'and edit my videos from now on' but runs straight into the abandoned 'because ... to build' line with no silence to cut on. The 0.5 s pause after 'I' (two sub-threshold silences 3.85-4.10, 4.12-4.37) is trimmed by hand to 0.18 s
Last clean take: 'because it was taking 30 minutes to one hour to edit a single video, which was not good'
'But it took' (retake of the open-loop line)
'quite a lot of time, which I will tell you in the end of the video'. Joined in the 80 ms dip after 'took' (both edges ≈ −48 dB)
The pipeline: 'But the basic thing goes like this ... then it's done. Post it.'
Loop closes: 'And it took me five hours to build the version one of it ... but it's something, and'
'the video you're watching right now is edited by this editor, so I would say this is a win, and this was episode two of making my tuition by January 15th'
